transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the transaction (UUID format)

status.description: Current execution status of the transaction

amount.description: Transaction monetary amount, restricted to positive values with up to two decimal places

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the transaction occurred, conforming to RFC 3339 / ISO 8601

destinationAccountId.description: Unique identifier or IBAN/account number for the target destination account

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR)

memo.description: Optional note or reference message attached to the transfer
